description: Single source of truth for parameters shared by several TT&C modules. Do not repeat these values in other data files; modules overlay them via ttc/parameters.py.

downlink_gross_bps.source: Preliminary 256 kbps X-band downlink, pending validation

protocol_overhead_fraction.source: Preliminary framing/protocol overhead; not a verified CCSDS figure

dsn_setup_minutes.source: Preliminary 15 min acquisition/setup per contact; NOT a verified DSN requirement

min_useful_tx_minutes.source: Smallest transmit time worth scheduling; minimum contact = setup + this value

dsn_daily_network_hours.source: Hypothetical DSN time for all 8 spacecraft; NOT a NASA allocation
